description: Run a VFX operation on an image already in the project gallery — the same pipeline the Resolve bridge uses. inpaint (clean plate: what is inside the box disappears, the surroundings close over it) · replace (same path, other intent: something new goes into the box) · relight (no box — the light direction moves across the whole frame) · mask (no box — you describe what should be cut out and get the matte back). inpaint/replace need `box` AND `prompt`; relight needs `light_preset` or `prompt` and REJECTS a box; mask needs `prompt` and REJECTS a box too. `box` is given in FRACTIONS of the image (0..1), not pixels — the worker builds the mask. inpaint/replace/relight cost 7-14 credits per run (by area); mask costs 1, flat per request. Returns immediately with an operation_id; poll lab_vfx_status until status is done|failed. NOT offered here: composite, move, color_grade — the server knows them and has no consumer for them.

box_breite.description: Box width as a fraction of image width

box_hoehe.description: Box height as a fraction of image height

box_x.description: Box left edge as a fraction of image width (0..1)

box_y.description: Box top edge as a fraction of image height (0..1)

image_id.description: Id of the source image in the project gallery (from lab_list_assets / lab_generate)

light_preset.description: relight only. There is no 'bottom' — the server does not carry one

operation.description: inpaint: Die rote Werkzeugkiste wird durch eine Holzkiste auf der Werkbank ersetzt. | replace: Derselbe Weg, andere Absicht: in die Box kommt etwas Neues. | relight: Keine Box: die Lichtrichtung wandert über das ganze Bild. | mask: Keine Box: du beschreibst, was heraus soll, und bekommst die Maske.

prompt.description: inpaint/replace: what should be seen there instead — required. mask: what should be cut out (e.g. 'the red toolbox') — required. relight: optional, replaces the preset

name: lab_vfx
title: VFX Operation
